overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Maine Municipal Projects & Public Property Committee was scheduled to meet to review and approve meeting minutes, examine the roads spreadsheet and project priorities, and conduct routine administrative business on November 18th, 2026.

agenda.item: Discussion and Possible Action – Approve minutes of the 09/22/2026 meeting
Schedule next meeting & member assigned to take minutes

discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to review and consider approving the minutes from the previous meeting held on September 22nd, 2026. This was set for discussion and possible action.

The committee was set to discuss and review a roads spreadsheet during the meeting. The agenda indicates this item was scheduled for both discussion and review of municipal road information or status.
The committee was scheduled to discuss the project priority list at this meeting. This item was set for discussion to potentially inform future municipal planning and project decisions.
